## Install on macOS

1. Download {zip-name} from this release. Pick the file for your CPU (Apple Silicon is `osx-arm64`).
2. Extract it into its own folder and run `./VRCFaceTracking` from there.

If Gatekeeper blocks the app, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the extracted folder and start it again. SteamVR features don't work on macOS.
